errors.evidence: The line representing the Transformer model is red or brownish-red, not orange.
The horizontal line for the Transformer model is at a value of approximately 11.6. It is clearly below the halfway point between 11.5 and 12.0, so 11.7 is a significant overestimation.
The description fails to mention the square markers on the 'MoHD' line, which is a distinguishing feature of that data series.
The description omits the light blue shaded area between the two lines, which is a prominent visual feature that highlights the performance difference between the two models.
